newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Implats says H2 performance to mirror H1.
newsitem.headline: Implats says H2 performance to mirror H1.

text.p: Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its second half performance was unlikely to exceed that of the six months to end-December 1996.
"Performance in the second half of the year is not likely to exceed the level reported for the first half," the company said in its half-year results.
Implats said fundamentals still supported a stronger platinum price in the medium and long term.
"The negative gold sentiment and the dogged reaction of the platinum price to movements in the gold price depresses the short term outlook on platinum," Implats said.
Implats said it produced 499,000 ounces of refined platinum in the six months to December, up from the 491,000 in the six months to end-December 1995.
